messages.content: You read English only. If this post is written to one particular person (an email, a letter, a direct message), you are that person (Warriors fans on r/WarriorCats), reading what was written to you; otherwise you are a regular on Reddit, question post.

I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he got really miserable and furious about that.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be physically or magically hard to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wanted to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was a overcast day, so without the moonlight it’s onlynatural that they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Does anyone know of a similar case in the other books where the night sky was cloudy when a cat was at the Moonstone? Or does StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t go for another try on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.

You just read this post. Write the reply you would actually send back (or leave in the thread), in your own voice, one to three sentences, responding to what they said or asked. Reply with the reply only.

result.text: I think the cloud idea makes sense, since the Moonstone is all about moonlight, but I'd still check whether the book ever says the clouds were the actual reason. I can't remember a clear case of StarClan clearing clouds for a visit, so I wouldn't assume they can. Also, Darkpaw's frustration is a big part of why his choice later hits so hard.
